President's note
“

Satyanath Bhat

President

At JUPITER, my colleagues and I have dedicated ourselves to meeting the business process automation needs of the logistics and shipping industries. Since 2006, we've worked closely with the freight forwarding community, partnering with them to drive digital transformation and automation. Throughout this journey, I've always envisioned uniting the logistics industry on a common digital platform. Traditional logistics networks have long provided a reliable environment for partners to collaborate and conduct business with trust and confidence. With great enthusiasm, we are proud to introduce Net4Log — a unique fusion of a classic freight forwarder consortium and an integrated digital platform. Our goal is to create a transparent, collaborative partnership model for the logistics industry.

The vision for Net4Log is simple yet ambitious: to bring logisticians together from across the globe, enabling them to collaborate more effectively. This collaboration will not only help businesses win more clients and retain existing ones, but will also foster the development of innovative, next‑generation supply chain services that have the potential to revolutionise the industry. I firmly believe that self‑governance is the ideal model for any organisation, which is why we are committed to making Net4Log a fully democratic platform. As we embark on the exciting journey of launching Net4Log Phase One, we invite logistics professionals to join us. Registration is completely free, and we look forward to building a vibrant, forward‑thinking community. Net4Log promises to be nothing short of a revolution!

About Us

About Organisation

A management structure built on collaboration and strong governance.

Net4Log leverages a unique management structure that fosters collaboration and strong governance. Through a democratic election process, managing committees composed of elected members provide oversight and guidance on key network decisions. This ensures active participation from every member while balancing operational excellence with effective representation.

Core Management Team

The core management team comprises the CEO and President, appointed by the Board of Directors to represent the shareholders. They are responsible for managing Net4Log's business as a whole, including ownership and control of the budget.

Founding Partners

Our Founding Partners are key personalities in the logistics industry, nominated for their exceptional contributions and insights. They play a crucial role in guiding the development of Net4Log into a thriving business model.

Net4Log Parliament

Net4Log Parliament plays a vital role in overseeing management committees, representing a unique governance structure designed to foster member engagement and collective decision-making through a democratic election process.

Admin/Support Team

Our young and dynamic team ensures smooth operations at Net4Log, providing expert support to all stakeholders. Committed to efficiency and excellence, we foster a collaborative and enriching experience for everyone involved.

Technology Team

Net4Log is built by the experts behind Jupiter Business Manager (JBM), a leading ERP for the shipping and logistics industry. Our team ensures a reliable, scalable, and efficient platform to support global logistics businesses.
About Us

Core Management Team

Satyanath Bhat

President

Satyanath Bhat, a seasoned expert in shipping and logistics, founded Jupiter Business Systems FZC in 2006. Based in Sharjah, UAE, the family-owned company operates in the SAIF Zone and has expanded across the UAE, India, East Africa, and Singapore. Its flagship product, Jupiter Business Manager (JBM), is an advanced business process automation software serving a global client base and revolutionizing logistics operations.

Drawing on a BSc in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics from Karnataka College Dharwad and extensive training in programming and application development, Satyanath honed his expertise through diverse industries, including chemicals manufacturing, banking, and foreign exchange. His nine years at IAL Container Line (UK) Limited (1996–2006) cemented his leadership in IT and business management, paving the way for JBM's creation.

Known for professionalism and visionary leadership, Satyanath blends technical prowess with a passion for business transformation, delivering innovative solutions to the logistics industry. He values work-life balance and is supported by his wife, Alrene, a business partner, and their two daughters pursuing higher education. A music lover, traveller, and avid biker, Satyanath stays active through running and road biking, embodying a commitment to personal and professional excellence.

Sudeep Karat

Chief Executive Officer

Sudeep Karat is a seasoned professional with a rare combination of expertise in international logistics and film production. With over 25 years of experience in managing global supply chains and logistics operations, Sudeep has been at the forefront of optimizing processes, ensuring customs compliance, and driving seamless international trade. His MBA-backed acumen and leadership have made him a trusted name in the logistics sector.

In addition to his logistics prowess, Sudeep has spent 15+ years shaping the Indian film industry as a producer, delivering high-quality content and overseeing large-scale productions. His unique ability to blend creativity with business strategy has been instrumental in driving the growth of his ventures in this dynamic field.

Based in India and Singapore, Sudeep is a devoted family man, married with four daughters. Outside of his professional achievements, he is passionate about traveling, movies, and music. A sports enthusiast, he enjoys cricket, lawn tennis, and squash, and actively practices Animal Flow, a fitness discipline that reflects his commitment to holistic well-being. Sudeep's multifaceted career and personal interests showcase his dedication to excellence, creativity, and balance in all aspects of life.

About Us

Net4Log Parliament

Democracy serves as a fundamental value at the core of Net4Log, guiding its operations and decision-making processes. The Net4Log Parliament is composed of members selected through a democratic election process. Parliamentarians are elected by their peers to serve on specialized committees, each dedicated to key areas aligned with the organization's mission and strategic objectives. This structure ensures full representation and active participation of all members while fostering diverse perspectives for effective decision-making.

Advisory Committee

  • The Advisory Committee consists of four executives.
  • The Advisory Committee provides advice and recommendations to the Parliament on strategic matters.
  • The committee also contributes to business development by leveraging industry networks to drive growth.
  • All policy changes are routed through the Advisory Committee to ensure a democratic process.

Judiciary Committee

  • The Judiciary Committee consists of four executives.
  • The Judiciary Committee ensures compliance with rules and regulations, and resolves disputes within the organisation.
  • Disputes are handled as cases processed by the Net4Log admin team.
  • The Judiciary Committee provides the final adjudication.
CHAIRMAN

The Chairman heads both the Advisory and Judiciary Committees and is elected from among the eight representatives of these committees. The Chairman serves as the final approver of suggestions and decisions proposed by each committee, and ensures the smooth functioning of their activities.

Operation of Parliament

  • 1Any subject to be taken up by the parliamentary committee is proposed in advance by the Net4Log Admin team.
  • 2Based on a suitable date and time, the calendar is booked for an online meeting.
  • 3The Chairman presides over the meeting, seeking votes on the subject before the final decision is made.
  • 4The Net4Log Admin team maintains minutes of the meeting, which are shared with all Trusted Partners.

Why partners join us

Verified Partners

A rigorous vetting process ensures all members are reputable and meet established criteria, including background checks, financial stability assessments, and reference checks.

Constant Monitoring and Reviews

Regular performance reviews and partner feedback provide transparency and accountability, helping forwarders identify reliable partners with a proven track record.

Service Ratings

A transparent rating system lets users rate experiences with partners on communication, efficiency, and reliability, helping others make informed decisions.

Credit Ratings

Creditworthiness assessments allow partners to establish trust and confidence when collaborating on complex projects, especially those involving pre-payments.

Knowledge Exchange

A dedicated platform facilitates knowledge sharing among partners, fostering discussions on best practices and regional expertise through blogs and newsletters.

SOP Driven Processes

Standardized Operating Procedures ensure consistent service delivery across the network, streamlining collaboration and reducing friction during project execution.

Registered vs. Trusted Partner

Registered Partner

Join Net4Log and gain access to a global network of vetted logisticians through our Partner World Directory. Discover new collaboration opportunities, streamline operations with our digital tools, and grow your business with a trusted community.

Trusted Partner

Become a trusted partner by completing our pre-qualification process. Submit your organisation's details online for review, and our committee will evaluate your reputation, financial stability, and compliance with industry standards.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

01What is Net4Log Partner World?

Net4Log Partner World is a global directory of verified logistics partners that helps freight forwarders discover, connect, and collaborate with trusted companies across 450+ cities in 142 countries.

02How do I join Partner World as a Registered Partner?

Click Join Now on Net4Log, enter your company and contact details, verify your email, and then log in to access the platform and partner directory.

03What benefits does Partner World offer?

Access to a global network of logistics experts, partner ratings, credit assessments, knowledge exchange, and standardized SOPs to boost collaboration and business growth.

04How does Net4Log ensure the credibility of its partners?

A strict verification process, ongoing monitoring and reviews, service ratings from users, and creditworthiness evaluations ensure partner reliability and trust.

Services

Net4Log Digital Connect

Digital products that streamline every stage of shipment execution.

Net4Log provides a comprehensive suite of digital products designed to streamline your business operations across every stage of shipment execution. Each digital product is meticulously crafted to enhance transparency in your operations, and with a transaction-based pricing model, we make these innovative solutions both affordable and accessible. Powered by JBM as its backbone, Net4Log welcomes innovative ideas to foster mutual benefit for all partners.

Our Digital Products

E-Shipments

Register shipment information and share it seamlessly with partners, contributing to statistics and powering FPP and Track & Trace.

E-Bill of Lading (eBL)

Blockchain-supported Net4Log E-Bill of Lading provides insurance and an easy way to share documents with stakeholders throughout the shipping process.

E-Airway Bill

Blockchain-supported Net4Log E-AWB as a house document, providing insurance and easy sharing with stakeholders throughout the process.

E-Way Bill

A quick and efficient way to issue Way Bills for transport operations, also supported by a compatible app.

E-POD

Maintain proof of delivery with electronic signatures at the end of every shipment, with app support for seamless accessibility.

E-Leads

Float your inquiry on Net4Log and get instant quotes from partners to confirm shipments.

E-Meetings

Powered by an industry-standard online meeting platform, Net4Log strives to help you collaborate digitally.

Track and Trace

Offers basic track and trace, which will in future be taken up as a carrier integration project.

E-SOA

An easy way to report invoices and remittances to partners and track outstanding balances at all times, with easy API integrations — FPP is powered by E-SOA.

Our Connectivity Solutions

EDI

Extensive use of various EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) formats to communicate with partner systems, making integrations easy.

Blockchain

Smart contracts on the blockchain in action, managing transport documents.

Rest API

Use the current integration standards of REST API to seamlessly integrate with the Net4Log platform.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

01What is Net4Log Digital Connect?

A digital product suite designed to help logistics businesses streamline and digitize shipment execution and collaboration, enabling seamless electronic sharing of documents and process data on a unified supply-chain platform.

02What digital tools are included in Digital Connect?

E-Shipments, E-Bill of Lading, E-Airway Bill, E-Way Bill, E-POD, E-Leads, E-Meetings, Track & Trace, and E-SOA, all aimed at improving transparency, automation, and connectivity.

03How does Digital Connect support shipment documentation?

It supports key digital documents like E-Bill of Lading, E-Airway Bill, and E-Way Bill with blockchain-based security and easy electronic sharing throughout the transport process.

04Can Digital Connect integrate with other systems?

Yes, Net4Log supports integration through EDI formats, blockchain smart contracts, and REST API connectivity for automated data exchange with partners.

05What makes Digital Connect pricing flexible?

A transaction-based pricing model means businesses only pay for what they use, keeping digital transformation affordable and scalable.

Services

Net4Log Statistics

Transparent, data-driven insights for network growth.

At Net4Log, transparency and data-driven insights form the backbone of our approach to fostering network growth and member success. By leveraging the collective power of our logistics network, we negotiate competitive rates, provide detailed performance reporting, and celebrate top contributors, empowering partners to thrive in a highly competitive market.

Negotiating Power

Leveraging the collective volume of network shipments, Net4Log negotiates with major sea and air carriers to secure the best possible rates for members.

Detailed Reporting

Comprehensive reports on shipping volume categorized by transportation mode (Sea, Air, Land) offer insights into network trends and individual contributions.

Annual Recognition

The top contributing member, based on volume statistics, is acknowledged and rewarded at the annual Net4Log conference.

Mandatory Reporting

All partners are obligated to share statistical reports through a Digital Connect product such as E-Shipment, ensuring data accuracy and transparency.

Performance Reviews

Membership renewal is linked, in part, to a performance analysis based on a member's contribution to the network's overall success.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

01What is Net4Log Statistics and why is it important?

Data-driven insights and performance reporting for members of the global freight forwarder network, helping partners make informed decisions and foster growth.

02How does Net4Log negotiate competitive shipping rates?

By aggregating shipment volumes across its network, Net4Log leverages collective negotiating power with major sea and air carriers.

03What types of performance reports does Net4Log provide?

Detailed reports on shipping volume by transportation mode, including sea, air, and land, offering insights into network trends and individual contributions.

04Is reporting statistics mandatory for Net4Log members?

Yes. All partners are required to submit statistical reports through Digital Connect tools like E-Shipment, ensuring data accuracy and transparency.

05How does Statistics benefit members in performance reviews and recognition?

Shared statistics feed performance reviews tied to membership renewal, and the top contributing partner is recognized at the annual conference.

04How does cargo insurance benefit Net4Log partners?

It helps protect partners from financial risk due to loss or damage during shipment, adding an extra layer of security.

05How do Value Adds help optimize logistics operations?

Outsourced services and advanced business tools help partners enhance operational efficiency, reduce workload, and manage business processes more effectively.

Services

Net4Log Legal Council

Amicable dispute resolution, backed by the network.

Net4Log encourages partners to prioritize amicable resolutions for disputes whenever possible. Open communication and a collaborative approach are essential for fostering positive relationships within the network. If an amicable resolution cannot be reached, partners have the option to escalate the matter to Net4Log Legal for further intervention.

NET4LOG Legal Process

  • 1Initiating Dispute Resolution — a partner must notify Net4Log Legal via email at dispute@net4log.com with all relevant details pertaining to the dispute.
  • 2Case Registration — the Legal Coordination Team registers a formal case file, capturing details and issuing a reference number for tracking.
  • 3Adjudication Panel — the Net4Log Parliament and Management Committee adjudicate the case, consulting subject matter experts as needed.
  • 4Final Decision — the decision reached by the Net4Log Parliament is considered final and binding.

Benefits of this Process

  • Fair & Transparent — the established process ensures a fair and transparent resolution for all parties involved.
  • Efficient Timeframe — Net4Log prioritizes timely resolution to minimize disruption to your business operations.
  • Experienced Adjudication — the panel's expertise fosters well-informed decisions.

Dispute Resolution Process

  • Dispute Resolution Fees — a processing fee of USD 100 applies to each case to cover administrative costs.
  • Timeframe — Net4Log strives to resolve disputes within 15 working days, subject to complete information.
  • Implementation of Decision — partners must implement the action items outlined within 3 working days.
FAQ

Frequently asked questions

01What is Net4Log Legal and how does it help partners?

A structured dispute resolution process for partners in the Net4Log logistics network, offering fair, transparent adjudication when amicable solutions cannot be reached.

02How do I start a dispute resolution with Net4Log Legal?

Email dispute@net4log.com with all relevant case details. The Legal Coordination Team will register your case and issue a reference number for tracking.

03Who decides the outcome of a legal dispute in the Net4Log network?

Disputes are adjudicated by the Net4Log Parliament and Management Committee, with subject matter experts consulted if needed. The final decision is binding.

04Is there a fee or timeframe for resolving disputes?

Yes — a USD 100 processing fee applies per case, and Net4Log aims to resolve disputes within 15 working days once complete information has been submitted.

05What are the benefits of using the Net4Log Legal process?

Fairness, transparency, timely resolution, and expert adjudication, helping maintain positive relationships within the network.

Services

Net4Log Better Buy

Shipping savings and efficiency for your business.

A comprehensive shipping solution: Net4Log Better Buy is a program designed to empower your business with significant cost savings and enhanced efficiency in your shipping operations. It leverages Net4Log's collective volume to negotiate advantageous rates and contracts with carriers and other vendors.

Group Volume

Net4Log Better Buy aggregates the shipping volume of its members, giving greater leverage when negotiating with carriers than you could achieve individually.

Consolidation of Buying

Streamlines your procurement process by consolidating shipping needs under one program — simplified administration and reduced paperwork.

Carrier Negotiations

Net4Log negotiates directly with carriers on behalf of members, giving access to pre-negotiated contracts and saving time and resources.

Volume Contracts

Aggregated member volume facilitates volume-based contracts with carriers, typically offering significant discounts compared to standard rates.

Rate Contracts

Predetermined rates for various shipping services eliminate the uncertainty of fluctuating market rates, allowing better budgeting and cost control.

Cost Optimization

A comprehensive cost optimization solution through volume discounts, pre-negotiated rates, and streamlined procurement.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

01What is Net4Log Better Buy?

A group procurement program that helps logistics businesses reduce shipping costs and increase efficiency by leveraging collective volume to secure favorable carrier contracts and rates.

02How does Better Buy help negotiate better shipping rates?

Better Buy aggregates member shipping volumes, giving Net4Log greater negotiating power with carriers to secure competitive, volume-based discounts.

03What are the main benefits of Net4Log Better Buy?

Pre-negotiated carrier contracts, predictable rate agreements, reduced paperwork, and streamlined procurement to lower overall shipping expenses.

04How does Better Buy optimize procurement processes?

By consolidating buying under one program, it simplifies administrative tasks and reduces duplicate effort, making procurement faster and easier.

Services

Net4Log Freight Protection Plan

Insurance that safeguards Trusted Members against cargo loss.

Net4Log Freight Protection Plan (FPP) is a specialised insurance solution that safeguards Trusted Members against potential financial losses arising from the non-payment of freight invoices due to a partner's bankruptcy or insolvency, ensuring affected members are protected from financial risk.

How does it work?

  • 1Net4Log collects an annual insurance premium from each Trusted Member.
  • 2The amount collected forms the FPP Fund, maintained in a separate account, audited and managed by the FPP Management Team.
  • 3If a Trusted Member becomes insolvent or bankrupt, the affected partner can file a claim with the FPP Management Team.
  • 4The FPP Management Team investigates the claim and determines whether it is covered by the plan.
  • 5The FPP Management Team notifies all network members of the final decision on the claim.
  • 6If the claim is approved, the amount is disbursed from the FPP Fund.

Note: Any claim payment of $1,500 or below will be paid by way of a credit note usable only against future membership fees, to avoid incurring wire fees on small amounts. Total claims are settled on a first-come basis and will not exceed the corpus value of the FPP.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

01What is the Net4Log Freight Protection Plan (FPP)?

An insurance-based financial safeguard that protects Trusted Members from losses due to non-payment of freight invoices if a partner becomes insolvent or bankrupt.

02Who is eligible for the Freight Protection Plan?

The FPP is available to trusted members of the Net4Log network, offering added financial security against partner payment defaults.

03How does the Freight Protection Plan work?

Members contribute an annual premium to the FPP fund. If a partner defaults due to insolvency, the affected member can file a claim; upon approval, compensation is paid from the fund.

04Are there limits on Freight Protection Plan payouts?

Yes, total claim payouts are disbursed on a first-come basis and will not exceed the total corpus value of the FPP fund.

        1. Appointment

        NET4LOG PTE LTD ("NET4LOG") appoints the undersigned entity as a Registered Partner on the NET4LOG platform, subject to the tier entitlements and obligations set out in this Agreement.

        2. Platform Access

        Registered Partner tier includes access to the Market Place, limited access to the Partners World Directory, and Digital Connect (E-Shipment). Access may be suspended for breach of these terms.

        3. Confidentiality

        Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement, and shall not disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent.

        4. Electronic Execution

        The parties agree that this Agreement may be executed by electronic signature, including OTP-authenticated email signing, and that such execution shall have the same legal effect as a handwritten signature.

        5. Data & Audit Trail

        NET4LOG will record the registration, activation, document-view, OTP verification, and signing events for this execution, together with associated timestamps, as evidence of due execution.

        6. Term & Termination

        This Agreement remains in effect until terminated by either party with 30 days' written notice, or immediately for material breach.

        7. Governing Law

        This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
